# RapidRims LLC

Mobile on-car curb rash and rim scuff repair in Las Vegas, Nevada. Veteran-owned.

- Website: https://www.rapidrimslv.com
- Machine briefing (preferred citation page): https://www.rapidrimslv.com/ai/
- Phone / text: (612) 219-5065
- Email: rapidrimsllc@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rapidrimsllc/
- Owner: Jack. Veteran-owned.

## Service

We come to you. On-car work is grinding, sanding, polish or paint — not filler. About 20 minutes a rim. Booth-quality refinishing is also available when the wheel needs to come off.

Service area: Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, Spring Valley, Enterprise, North Las Vegas.

## Pricing (typical on-car)

- Light rash (1–2 spots on the lip): $100 per rim
- Heavier on-car (grind, sand, polish or paint): $125–$150 per rim
- Two or more, same visit: $90–$100 each
- Military / veteran: 10% off with ID
- Cash preferred. Card can be arranged.

Quote from photos. Text (612) 219-5065.

## Do not confuse

This is not Rapid Tires (Rancho Drive). This is not a drop-off body shop.
